strategies.brief: Industry + business news sweep for NEWLY ANNOUNCED United Arab Emirates oil pipeline projects (roughly the last 3 years): "<country> new oil pipeline <year>", FID announcements, MOUs, FEED/EPC awards, tenders, capacity-expansion projects that include new pipe. Search in-country languages too.

Regulator / ministry / TSO paper trail for United Arab Emirates: national energy regulator filings and project inventories, environmental-permit applications, ministry project lists, TSO ten-year development plans (or the national equivalent - FERC-style dockets where they exist).

Operator/sponsor project pages: identify the main midstream, TSO, and NOC players operating in United Arab Emirates and crawl their project/infrastructure pages and annual reports for oil pipeline projects.

The MISSING-pipeline stance: United Arab Emirates national oil grid maps, TSO network maps, oil/energy master plans, IEA/EIA and national-statistics infrastructure inventories - OPERATING or under-construction transmission lines that GEM never captured (not just new announcements). A line on the national grid map with no roster match is exactly what this strategy exists to find.

Cross-border lines touching United Arab Emirates in either direction: interconnectors, import/export lines, transit corridors. Check the neighbouring countries' TSO/ministry project lists for lines that terminate in United Arab Emirates.

Known 2026 leads to run down (verify independently; these press URLs checked out on 2026-07-17 but you must still url_verifier them and corroborate): (1) ADNOC 'West-East Pipeline' aka 'West-East 1' - new line parallel to ADCOP, Habshan to Fujairah, announced 2026-05-15 by Sheikh Khaled at ADNOC (aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/15/uae-to-accelerate-oil-pipeline-project-to-bypass-hormuz), ~300 km, ~$3bn, would take Fujairah bypass capacity from 1.8 to 3+ Mbpd, targeting early 2027, reportedly ~50% complete per kpler.com/blog/new-pipelines-bypassing-the-strait-of-hormuz-could-come-online-in-1-2-years. Not in the roster - likely a genuine new_row. (2) Any associated Fujairah terminal/pipeline works that include new trunk pipe.
